audit_items.proof_trace: Property states mutations require snapshot bracket. BuyGas/IncrementNonce (lines 170-171) mutate state before ExecuteEvmCall's TakeSnapshot (line 627). However, these pre-snapshot mutations are intentional: they represent irreversible transaction costs (gas payment, nonce) that must persist even if EVM execution fails. The snapshot at line 627 protects only the EVM execution state, not the transaction envelope state.
